done.why: I went down the rope to the ledge and could not climb back up. The chest was locked and nothing else was in reach, so I stopped after a short sample.

about: A sequel-style underground adventure. I arrive at the bottom of an endless stair with my old brass lantern, after a dream in which a silver-haired old man tells me to seek him when I feel worthy. There is a sword stuck in a rock, a sunlit oasis cliff with a rope, and a locked chest.

moments.note: Walking south into the dark gave a grue warning, and I had not turned the lantern on yet.
The sword's hilt is worn to the shape of my own hand. That is a nice, quiet touch.
The sunlit oasis of giant trees, two hundred feet below a hole in the surface, is a striking place.
The chest description says it 'will not' open for me. It does not say why or what would open it.
The rope can't be climbed back up. The ledge warned that I probably couldn't return, but I still felt trapped after one obvious move.

wished: To learn what the chest or the sword needs.
To get back up the rope after being warned I might not be able to.
To follow the movement among the trees.

lines.line: It has the look of an old friend who has followed you somewhere it would rather not have come.
lines.why: It gives the lantern character and gives the sequel a sense of history.

lines.line: a hilt worn to the shape of a hand, which, when you close yours on it, turns out to be yours.
lines.why: It is a graceful, evocative line.

lines.line: It has the look of a thing that somebody wants, and not the look of a thing that will open for you.
lines.why: It is well written, and it hints at a story without spelling it out.

fun.why: The world is pleasant to read, but I saw very little of it and got stuck early.

engagement.why: The dream opening and the details I examined drew me in, but the dead end on the ledge cut it short.

difficulty.why: I was stuck quickly with no clear route. The rope and chest left me with little to try, so it felt slightly too hard.

interestingness.why: The setting is intriguing: a sequel with a sword in a rock, a sunlit oasis, a mysterious figure, and a chest someone wants.

prose.why: The prose is evocative and carefully voiced, especially in the examine texts. A few responses were plain and flat.
